name: @kkiyama117/dsh-observed-trace-emitter
description: Harness-observed emitter for the implement-task Quint replay gate: listens to the Cordis tools/result event (fires on every tool dispatch, independent of the agent) and appends each observed tool call to a per-session spec/replay/trace.observed.<sid>.jsonl log, so the replay check runs on what the agent actually did, not what it self-reports. Experimental telemetry, not an enforcement gate.
